items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Oh, I was working before I left Nazarro I was working for Joe Glaser.

ctx.x: Louis Armstrong. When did you start working for Joe Glaser?

Oh, I was working before I left Nazarro I was working for Joe Glaser. That club in Canada? Joe Glaser was mixed up in that, too. They were booked together. Togetherness. Maybe he put the shows in, maybe
Joe Glaser had the shows to put in and he used Buck and Bubbles in the show. That's why we were connected with that.
